## What's in the sandbox

<SandboxBlocks blocks={[
  {
    "p": [
      {
        "text": "The sandbox contains "
      },
      {
        "text": "an MPLS backbone",
        "href": "/infrahub-demo-sp/#architecture-at-a-glance"
      },
      {
        "text": " of PE routers running IS-IS, LDP and iBGP, customer edge routers, and example L3VPN and SD-WAN services."
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "p": [
      {
        "text": "When you request an L3VPN in the portal, the portal creates a branch, the service and a Proposed Change, Infrahub's equivalent of a pull request, in Infrahub. A Generator then creates "
      },
      {
        "text": "the VRF, route targets, interfaces, IP addresses and BGP sessions",
        "href": "/infrahub-demo-sp/services/l3vpn#generator-what-it-creates"
      },
      {
        "text": " for each site, and Infrahub renders "
      },
      {
        "text": "the configuration of each PE router",
        "href": "/infrahub-demo-sp/services/l3vpn#per-vendor-configuration"
      },
      {
        "text": " from the same service. "
      },
      {
        "text": "SD-WAN services",
        "href": "/infrahub-demo-sp/services/sdwan"
      },
      {
        "text": " and "
      },
      {
        "text": "new PE routers",
        "href": "/infrahub-demo-sp/backbone/add-pe#user-flow"
      },
      {
        "text": " follow the same pattern."
      }
    ]
  }
]} />

![An MPLS backbone in AS 65000 of eight PE routers, from pe-01 in London to pe-08 in Zurich. Two customers each have a customer edge router in London and one in Zurich: markets-trading in AS 65100, joined by the L3VPN trading-floor-vpn, and investment-banking in AS 65101, joined by the L3VPN ib-advisory-vpn. The SD-WAN treasury-branch-sdwan joins a hub in London to spokes in Frankfurt and Amsterdam.](./img/demo-sp.svg)
